summary: A Depth subscription on an NFO future: Flattrade's depth snapshot (dk) gives a Depth frame with the quote, OI and the five-level book; a partial (df) moves the best levels and the OI; a book of zeros clears every level; the unsubscribe releases the depth subscription.

notes: Noren sends OI as oi and toi; the desktop takes toi for every member when present (audit FB-07). The web's Flattrade adapter sends toi as total_traded_value, and no OI key. The partial carries an oi change without toi to show which one each side reads.
Circuits, 52-week values and depth_level are web fields the desktop's carrier does not have yet (audit C06).

deviations.reason: The web's Flattrade adapter sends 52_week_high in Depth frames; the desktop's common carrier has no place for it yet.
The web's Flattrade adapter sends 52_week_low in Depth frames; the desktop's common carrier has no place for it yet.
The web's Flattrade adapter sends depth_level in Depth frames; the desktop's common carrier has no place for it yet.
The web forwards Noren's feed time ft (epoch seconds) as flattrade_timestamp; the desktop drops it.
The web's Flattrade adapter forwards Noren's trade time ltt (HH:MM:SS, null when the frame has none) as last_trade_time; the desktop's carrier has no place for it.
The web's Flattrade adapter sends lower_circuit in Depth frames; the desktop's common carrier has no place for it yet.

The desktop sends Noren's feed time ft, in ms, as ltt: a packet time, not the trade time. Noren's trade time is its ltt (HH:MM:SS, IST), which the web forwards raw as last_trade_time; the web's Flattrade adapter sends no ltt key in any mode, LTP included. Closed in phase B by the per-broker dialect switch (lane wire), set to what this adapter does (lead rule 2026-11-09).

The web's Flattrade adapter puts its subscription mode number (1, 2, 3) in data.mode; the desktop sends the label (ltp, quote, full) for every broker. Closed in phase B by the per-broker dialect switch (lane wire), set to what this adapter does (lead rule 2026-11-09).

The desktop sends OI as both oi and open_interest for every broker; the web's Flattrade adapter sends no OI key. Closed in phase B by the per-broker dialect switch (lane wire), set to what this adapter does (lead rule 2026-11-09).

The desktop sends OI as both oi and open_interest for every broker; the web's Flattrade adapter labels Noren's toi total_traded_value instead. Closed in phase B by the per-broker dialect switch (lane wire), set to what this adapter does (lead rule 2026-11-09).
The web's Flattrade adapter forwards Noren's pc as percent_change for every instrument; the desktop sends the change fields for indices only.

The web's Flattrade adapter sends Noren's toi as total_traded_value; Noren documents toi as the total open interest, which the desktop sends as oi and open_interest. Which reading is right needs a captured frame and the lead's decision before the desktop adds or declines this key.
The web's Flattrade adapter sends upper_circuit in Depth frames; the desktop's common carrier has no place for it yet.
